title: Workday Jobs - Careers, Descriptions & 招聘职位
description: Minimal working input: {"careerUrls": ["https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite"], "searchQuery": "", "includeDescriptions": true, "locationContains": ""}. Default maximum 20 paid job rows; only delivered rows billed.

careerUrls.title: careerUrls
careerUrls.description: Workday career-board URLs, e.g. ["https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite"]. Only myworkdayjobs.com boards; individual job URLs rejected. One page budget per board.

searchQuery.title: searchQuery
searchQuery.description: Keyword search within supplied employer boards, e.g. "engineer". Empty means all visible board jobs. Does not discover employers. No query fee.

includeDescriptions.title: includeDescriptions
includeDescriptions.description: true (DEFAULT) fetches each Workday job detail; included in the same job price. Set false for a faster list with description=null. This does not change the per-row price.

locationContains.title: locationContains
locationContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring in source location fields, e.g. "London". Empty disables it. Applied before billing; not a radius or geocoding search.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the entire run, after filters and exclusions. Example: 20. May return fewer when source pages end or maxPages is reached.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Maximum source pages per target, 1–20; default 3. Up to 20 listings per page per employer board; descriptions add detail requests but no extra row fee. Filters are free; maxResults can be lower than this scan budget.

includeKeywords.title: includeKeywords
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR substring filter on title and description (description only when included). Example: ["battery"]. Empty [] disables it. Applied before billing inside the page budget; not a semantic classifier or additional source search.
includeKeywords.sectionCaption: Filters and repeat runs / 筛选与去重

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Copy prior output id values here to skip before billing. id combines board hostname, site name and job path. Empty [] disables it. This also suppresses changes to existing IDs.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: SHA-256 content_hash values from previous output to skip unchanged snapshots before billing. Example: copy returned hashes. Empty [] disables it. Changed counters or content can produce a new paid snapshot.
